sentences.en: Section A The role of governments in environmental management is difficult but inescapable.
sentences.zh: A节政府在环境管理方面的作用是困难的,但不可回避。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Sometimes, the state tries to manage the resources it owns, and does so badly.
sentences.zh: 有时,国家试图管理它所拥有的资源, 并且做得太差。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Often, however, governments act in an even more harmful way.
sentences.zh: 然而,政府往往以更加有害的方式行事。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They actually subsidise the exploitation and consumption of natural resources.
sentences.zh: 它们实际上补贴自然资源的开发和消费。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A whole range of policies, from farmprice support to protection for coal-mining, do environmental damage and (often) make no economic sense.
sentences.zh: 一系列政策,从农业价格支持到保护煤矿开采,对环境的破坏和(往往)经济意义不大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Scrapping them offers a two-fold bonus: a cleaner environment and a more efficient economy.
sentences.zh: 砍伐这些土地可带来双重红利:一种清洁的环境和更有效的经济。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Growth and environmentalism can actually go hand in hand, if politicians have the courage to confront the vested interest that subsidies create.
sentences.zh: 如果政客有勇气面对补贴创造的既得利益,那么增长和环境主义实际上可以齐头并进。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Section B No activity affects more of the earth’s surface than farming.
sentences.zh: B节任何活动对地球表面的影响都大于耕作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It shapes a third of the planet’s land area, not counting Antarctica, and the proportion is rising.
sentences.zh: 它占地球陆地面积的三分之一,不计南极洲,而且比例正在上升。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: World food output per head has risen by 4 per cent between the 1970s and 1980s mainly as a result of increases in yields from land already in cultivation, but also because more land has been brought under the plough.
sentences.zh: 1970年代至1980年代,世界人均粮食产量上升4%,主要是因为已经耕种的土地产量增加,但也因为更多的土地被耕种。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Higher yields have been achieved by increased irrigation, better crop breeding, and a doubling in the use of pesticides and chemical fertilisers in the 1970s and 1980s.
sentences.zh: 增加灌溉、改善作物育种以及1970年代和1980年代杀虫剂和化肥的使用率翻了一番,提高了产量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Section C All these activities may have damaging environmental impacts.
sentences.zh: C节所有这些活动都可能对环境造成破坏性影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, land clearing for agriculture is the largest single cause of deforestation; chemical fertilisers and pesticides may contaminate water supplies; more intensive farming and the abandonment of fallow periods tend to exacerbate soil erosion; and the spread of mono-Culture and use of high-yielding varieties of crops have been accompanied by the disappearance of old varieties of food plants which might have provided some insurance against pests or diseases in future.
sentences.zh: 例如,农业土地清理是砍伐森林的最大单一原因;化肥和杀虫剂可能污染供水;更密集的耕作和放弃秋耕期往往加剧土壤侵蚀;单一文化的蔓延和使用高产作物品种,同时旧的粮食植物品种消失,这些作物可能为今后防治虫害或疾病提供了一些保险。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Soil erosion threatens the productivity of land in both rich and poor countries.
sentences.zh: 土壤侵蚀威胁到富国和穷国的土地生产力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The United States, where the most careful measurements have been done, discovered in 1982 that about one-fifth of its farmland as losing topsoil at a rate likely to diminish the soil’s productivity.
sentences.zh: 1982年,美国进行了最仔细的测量,发现大约五分之一的农田以可能降低土壤生产力的速度失去表土。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The country subsequently embarked upon a program to convert 11 per cent of its cropped land to meadow or forest.
sentences.zh: 该国随后开始执行一项方案,将11%的耕地转为草原或森林。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Topsoil in India and China is vanishing much faster than in America.
sentences.zh: 印度和中国的表土消失的速度要比美国快得多

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Section D Government policies have frequently compounded the environmental damage that farming can cause.
sentences.zh: 政府政策D节经常加重耕作可能造成的环境破坏。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the rich countries, subsidies for growing crops and price supports for farm output drive up the price of land.
sentences.zh: 在富国,种植作物补贴和农业产出价格支持导致土地价格上升。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The annual value of these subsidies is immense: about $250 billion, or more than all World Bank lending in the 1980s.To increase the output of crops per acre, a farmer’s easiest option is to use more of the most readily available inputs: fertilisers and pesticides.
sentences.zh: 这些补贴的年度价值是巨大的:大约2500亿美元,或者比1980年代世界银行的所有贷款都高。 为了提高每英亩作物的产量,农民最容易的选择就是更多地使用最容易得到的投入:化肥和杀虫剂。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Fertiliser use doubled in Denmark in the period 1960-1985 and increased in The Netherlands by 150 per cent.
sentences.zh: 1960-1985年期间,丹麦使用化肥的情况增加了一倍,荷兰增加了150%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The quantity of pesticides applied has risen too; by 69 per cent in 1975-1984 in Denmark, for example, with a rise of 115 per cent in the frequency of application in the three years from 1981.
sentences.zh: 杀虫剂施用量也有所增加;例如,丹麦1975-1984年施用农药的频率增加了69%,1981年以后三年,施用频率增加了115%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the late 1980s and early 1990s some efforts were made to reduce farm subsidies.
sentences.zh: 1980年代末和1990年代初,为减少农业补贴作出了一些努力。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The most dramatic example was that of New Zealand, which scrapped most farm support in 1984.
sentences.zh: 最突出的例子就是新西兰,1984年新西兰取消了大部分农业支助。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: A study of the environmental effects, conducted in 1993, found that the end of fertiliser subsidies had been followed by a fall in fertiliser use (a fall compounded by the decline in world commodity prices, which cut farm incomes).
sentences.zh: 1993年进行的关于环境影响的研究发现,化肥补贴结束后化肥的使用下降(世界商品价格下跌使化肥的使用下降,使农业收入减少,使价格下降更为严重)。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The removal of subsidies also stopped land-clearing and over-stocking, which in the past had been the principal causes of erosion.
sentences.zh: 取消补贴也停止了清理土地和超量储存,而过去,这是侵蚀的主要原因。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Farms began to diversify.
sentences.zh: 农场开始多样化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The one kind of subsidy whose removal appeared to have been bad for the environment was the subsidy to manage soil erosion.
sentences.zh: 一种补贴的取消似乎对环境有害,一种补贴是管理土壤侵蚀的补贴。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In less enlightened countries, and in the European Union, the trend has been to reduce rather than eliminate subsidies, and to introduce new payments to encourage farmers to treat their land in environmentally friendlier ways, or to leave it follow.
sentences.zh: 在开明程度较低的国家和欧洲联盟,趋势是减少而不是取消补贴,并引入新的付款办法,鼓励农民以环境友好的方式对待自己的土地,或随后离开。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It may sound strange but such payments need to be higher than the existing incentives for farmers to grow food crops.
sentences.zh: 这可能听起来很奇怪,但这种付款必须高于农民种植粮食作物的现有奖励措施。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Farmers, however, dislike being paid to do nothing.
sentences.zh: 然而,农民不喜欢被收买,不做任何事情。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In several countries they have become interested in the possibility of using fuel produced from crop residues either as a replacement for petrol (as ethanol) or as fuel for power stations (as biomass).
sentences.zh: 在几个国家,它们已经对利用作物残留物产生的燃料取代汽油(作为乙醇)或作为发电站燃料(作为生物量)的可能性感兴趣。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Such fuels produce far less carbon dioxide than coal or oil, and absorb carbon dioxide as they grow.
sentences.zh: 此类燃料产生的二氧化碳远远低于煤炭或石油,随着其增长吸收二氧化碳。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They are therefore less likely to contribute to the greenhouse effect.
sentences.zh: 因此,它们较少可能助长温室效应。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But they die rarely competitive with fossil fuels unless subsidised – and growing them does no less environmental harm than other crops.
sentences.zh: 但他们很少死在化石燃料的竞争中,除非得到补贴 — — 种植化石燃料不会比其他作物对环境造成危害更少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Section E In poor countries, governments aggravate other sorts of damage.
sentences.zh: E节在贫穷国家,政府加重其他种类的损害。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Subsidies for pesticides and artificial fertilisers encourage farmers to use greater quantities than are needed to get the highest economic crop yield.
sentences.zh: 对农药和人工化肥的补贴鼓励农民使用数量超过获得最高经济作物产量所需的数量。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A study by the International Rice Research Institute Of pesticide use by farmers in South East Asia found that, with pest-resistant varieties of rice, even moderate applications of pesticide frequently cost farmers more than they saved.
sentences.zh: 国际水稻研究所对东南亚农民使用农药情况进行的一项研究发现,由于有抗虫害的稻米品种,即使农药的中度应用也往往使农民付出的代价超过他们所节省的费用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Such waste puts farmers on a chemical treadmill: bugs and weeds become resistant to poisons, so next year’s poisons must be more lethal.
sentences.zh: 此类废物让农民走上化学运动场:虫子和杂草对毒药抗药性很强,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One cost is to human health, every year some 10,000 people die from pesticide poisoning, almost all of them in the developing countries, and another 400,000 become seriously ill.
sentences.zh: 一种代价是人类健康,每年约有1万人死于农药中毒,几乎全部在发展中国家,另有40万人病重。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As for artificial fertilisers, their use world-wide increased by 40 per cent per unit of farmed land between the mid 1970s and late 1980s, mostly in the developing countries.
sentences.zh: 至于人工化肥,在1970年代中期至1980年代末,全世界使用这些化肥的农用土地单位每单位增加40%,主要在发展中国家。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Overuse of fertilisers may cause farmers to stop rotating crops or leaving their land fallow.
sentences.zh: 过度使用化肥可能会使农民停止轮作作物或放弃土地落地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: That, In turn, may make soil erosion worse.
sentences.zh: 反过来,这又可能使土壤侵蚀恶化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Section F A result of the Uruguay Round of world trade negotiations is likely to be a reduction of 36 per cent in the average levels of farm subsidies paid by the rich countries in 1986-1990.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭回合世界贸易谈判的结果是,富国在1986-1990年期间支付的农场补贴平均水平可能减少36%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some of the world’s food production will move from Western Europe to regions where subsidies are lower or non-existent, such as the former communist countries and parts of the developing world.
sentences.zh: 世界的一些粮食生产将从西欧转移到补贴较低或不存在补贴的地区,例如前共产党国家和发展中世界部分地区。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some environmentalists worry about this outcome.
sentences.zh: 有些环保人士担心这一结果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It will undoubtedly mean more pressure to convert natural habitat into farmland.
sentences.zh: 这无疑意味着将自然生境转变为农田的压力更大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But it will also have many desirable environmental effects.
sentences.zh: 但它也将产生许多可取的环境影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The intensity of farming in the rich world should decline, and the use of chemical inputs will diminish.
sentences.zh: 富裕世界的耕作强度应下降,化学投入的使用将减少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Crops are more likely to be grown up in the environments to which they are naturally suited.
sentences.zh: 作物更有可能在自然适合的环境中生长。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: And more farmers in poor countries will have the money and the incentive to manage their land in ways that are sustainable in the long run.
sentences.zh: 穷国的农民将有更多资金和动力以长期可持续的方式管理自己的土地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: That is important.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: To feed an increasingly hungry world, farmers need every incentive to use their soil and water effectively and efficiently.
sentences.zh: 为了养活日益饥饿的世界,农民需要各种奖励,以便有效和高效地使用其土壤和水。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
